name: terraform-cost-comment
description: GitHub Action that comments the monthly AWS cost change of a Terraform plan on pull requests, priced by the AWS Pricing Calculator API.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run bundle
